stemMarkdown: A bag contains 3 red balls and 5 blue balls. Two balls are drawn at random without replacement. What is the probability that both are red? (Round to 6 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Choose 2 from the 3 red balls out of 2 from all 8: $\dfrac{\binom{3}{2}}{\binom{8}{2}} = \dfrac{3}{28} = 0.107143$.
